# yba_pa_collector (Data Source)

Perf Advisor Collector data source. Looks up the collector that scrapes universes for Perf Advisor, so its UUID can be passed to `yba_universe_perf_advisor_registration`.

~> **Note:** The embedded collector is created and managed by YBA itself and cannot be declared in Terraform. With no filter this data source returns the single configured collector, and errors if there is more than one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The embedded Perf Advisor collector. YBA creates and owns it, so it is looked
# up rather than declared; with a single collector configured no filter is
# needed.
data "yba_pa_collector" "embedded" {}

# A specific collector, when more than one is configured.
data "yba_pa_collector" "selected" {
  uuid = var.pa_collector_uuid
}

output "pa_collector_in_use" {
  value = data.yba_pa_collector.embedded.in_use_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the collector. Set to select a specific one.

### Read-Only

- `embedded` (Boolean) True when this is the embedded Perf Advisor that YBA manages itself.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `in_use_status` (String) Whether any universe is registered with this collector: IN_USE, NOT_IN_USE, or ERROR when the collector could not be reached.
- `metrics_scrape_period_secs` (Number) Scrape interval, in seconds.
- `metrics_url` (String) URL of the Prometheus the collector scrapes.
- `pa_url` (String) URL of the Perf Advisor the collector runs against.
- `yba_url` (String) URL the collector uses to reach this YBA.
